import os,json,subprocess,hashlib,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/lowcost-europa')
paths=['deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.service']
old=b'/srv/lowcost-europa'
new=b'/srv/projects/lowcost-europa'
def git(*args):
 try:return subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(root),'-C',str(root),*args],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
 except Exception:return None
report={'mode':'READ_ONLY','expected_main_sha':'58340ef2608cbdb927a0e97bf717b0f5321c5e09','files':{},'alias_target':None}
q=root.resolve(strict=True)
alias=Path('/srv/lowcost-europa')
report['alias_target']=str(alias.resolve(strict=True)) if alias.is_symlink() else None
r=git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')
report['fetched_main']=r.stdout.decode().strip() if r and r.returncode==0 else None
all_good=report['fetched_main']==report['expected_main_sha'] and report['alias_target']==str(root)
for rel in paths:
 p=root/rel
 data=p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() else None
 if data is None:
  report['files'][rel]={'error':'missing_or_symlink'}
  all_good=False;continue
 staged=data.replace(old,new)
 base=git('show','refs/remotes/origin/main:'+rel)
 changed=git('diff','--quiet','HEAD','--',rel)
 st=p.stat()
 entry={'uid':st.st_uid,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)),
        'old_ref_count':data.count(old),'new_ref_count':data.count(new),
        'after_replace_matches_fetched_main':bool(base and base.returncode==0 and base.stdout==staged),
        'tracked_dirty_before':not(bool(changed and changed.returncode==0)),
        'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        'candidate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(staged).hexdigest(),
        'number_bytes':len(data)}
 report['files'][rel]=entry
 if entry['old_ref_count']<1 or entry['uid']!=999 or entry['tracked_dirty_before'] or not entry['after_replace_matches_fetched_main']:
  all_good=False
report['candidate_ready']=all_good
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
